# Class `puc::logger::Logger`

Thread-safe logger that writes messages to the configured output streams.

Messages below either the global or module-specific log level are ignored. Error messages are written to standard error; all other messages are written to standard output. If configured, every emitted message is also appended to the log file without terminal color codes.
